newsitem.title: TURKEY: Turkey says 60 Kurd rebels dead in four days.
newsitem.headline: Turkey says 60 Kurd rebels dead in four days.

text.p: Turkish security officials said on Friday that the Kurdish rebel death toll in a big land and air offensive earlier this week had risen to 60.
The regional governor's office in the city of Diyarbakir said in a statement that the Kurdistan Workers Party (PKK) guerrillas had died in fighting near the Iraqi border between Monday and Thursday.
It said only two members of the security forces had died.
The office had said on Tuesday that 47 guerrillas had been killed in clashes in the border area and in the hinterland province of Tunceli.

Some 20,000 troops launched a separate drive against a small rebel contingent holed up in Tunceli this week but security officials have been unavailable for comment on any fighting there in recent days.
More than 20,000 people have died in the 12-year-old conflict between security forces and the PKK, fighting for Kurdish self-rule in the southeast.
